tha-ap352:1.1: Ekañjaliya.] Romaso nāma sambuddho nadīkūle vasī tadā / addasaṃ virajaṃ Buddhaṃ vītaraṃsīva bhāṇumaṃ // //
tha-ap352:2.1: Ukkāmukhaṃ pahaṭaṃ va khadiraṅgārasannibhaṃ / osadhī viya rocantam ekañja*lim* akās' ahaṃ. // //
tha-ap352:3.1: Catunavute ito kappe yam añjalim akās' ahaṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi añjaliyā idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap352:5.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Ekañjaliyo thero i. g. a-ti.
tha-ap352:9.1: Padum' Uppalahatthā ti Dhajo Kiṅkhaṇiko Nalo Campako Paduma-Muṭṭhī Tinduk' Ekañjalī tathā cha ca saṭṭhi ca gāthāyo gaṇitāyo vibhāvihi.
